content:
incidents-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for service `api-redwood-prod` in region eu-west-1. 5xx rate crossed 7% over 10m, traffic shifted ~30% -> initiating regional failover. paging @alex oncall.

alex: on it. seeing the spike, paging infra to confirm autoscaling/burst capacity. anyone on-call for dedicated pools?

maria: i'm here, looking at GCP logs and LB health checks. Initial look — backend instances in eu-west-1 show elevated latency + connection reset spikes.

jamal: adding context — we recently rolled a kernel upgrade on a subset of boxes in eu-west-1 last night (~0200 UTC). Could be related. rolling back is an option but prefer traffic shift + mitigate first.

ingrid: starting targeted failover to eu-central-1 per policy. routing rule `rr-proxy/failover-eu` will shift 25% traffic immediately, can push to 60% in 10m increments.

ops-bot: ACTION: runbook `regional-failover` invoked by @alex. Runbook steps: 1) divert traffic 2) increase retry/backoff 3) suppress noisy alerts 4) notify CS.

alex: doing step 1 now: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/routing/shifts -d '{"from":"eu-west-1","to":"eu-central-1","percent":25}'` — acknowledged, traffic shifting.

maria: enabling elevated backoff on client-facing routes (increase retry to 3s, jitter). Pushing config:```yaml
route: /v1/generate
client_retry: 3
retry_backoff_ms: 3000
```

jamal: to reduce noise, propose muting the `High5xxRate-eu-west-1` alert for 30m and create a temp combined alert for cross-region saturated nodes. Suggested alert update:```promql
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",status=~"5..",region="eu-west-1"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",region="eu-west-1"}[5m])) > 0.07
```

alex: muting original alert now and creating `CrossRegion-Error-Rate` with threshold 5% global, but annotate with region tagging so we can pivot quickly.

incidents-bot: NOTE: Alert `High5xxRate-eu-west-1` muted by alex for 30m. New alert `CrossRegion-Error-Rate` created (severity: warning).

maria: looking at logs — errors are primarily `ECONNRESET` from a specific subnet. Opening a ticket to infra with instance IDs and kernel boot logs.

jamal: meanwhile scaling dedicated pool in eu-west-1 by +2 replicas to reduce connection queueing. Command: `redwoodctl scale pool dedicated-eu-west-1 --add 2` — started.

ingrid: pushing next traffic shift to 60% to eu-central-1 now to reduce customer impact; monitoring latencies as we go.

alex: customer-impact update: CS notified via #customer-impact — affected tenants: approx 12% of production requests, degraded latency only for long-tail requests. We posted temporary status page note: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1712501234

sophia: coordinating handoff — i'm taking the night shift in 40m. what's current state?

alex: handoff notes: 1) failover in progress, currently 60% shifted to eu-central-1. 2) autoscale +2 in eu-west started. 3) `High5xxRate-eu-west-1` muted; watch `CrossRegion-Error-Rate`. 4) kernel-related hypothesis, rollback pending infra response. 5) temp dashboard created: https://console.redwood/dashboards/region-failover-1712501234 (contains per-region 5xx, p50/p95 latency, traffic split).

alex: @sophia please continue watch on `CrossRegion-Error-Rate` and the new dashboard. escalate to infra if node restarts >3 in 10m.

sophia: ack. I'll keep an eye and will open an infra incident if restarts spike.

incidents-bot: REMINDER: scheduled on-call handoff log — alex -> sophia at 1712504834.

maria: post-mitigation tasks (to do list):
- Create a long-term dashboard for multi-region health with traffic shift overlays.
- Add synthetic probes to compare p99 across regions every 2m.
- Tune `High5xxRate` to add dynamic thresholds using baseline per-region (avoid muting in future).
- Add playbook snippet to suppress alerts automatically during planned failovers.

jamal: will take ownership of dynamic threshold work. Proposed rule sketch:```promql
region_baseline = avg_over_time(error_rate{region=~".+"}[1h])
threshold = max(0.03, 3 * region_baseline)
error_rate > threshold
```

ingrid: i'll create the dashboard tiles and wire up the traffic-shift annotations so we can correlate deploys/rollouts with spikes.

alex: final note before handoff — we should not rollback kernel until infra confirms correlating crash logs; rollback can be noisy. prefer controlled validation first.

sophia: got it. watching logs and the new alerts. if any region crosses p95>1.2s or restarts>3, i'll page infra and escalate.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: degraded -> stabilizing. auto-updates every 5m.

maria: small follow-up — I've uploaded collected logs and boot traces to the ticket: https://internal.redwood/tickets/INFRA-7891. Also added candidate host list for rollback if needed.

alex: thanks team. leaving notes in the incident doc and marking action owners. handing off to @sophia. :thumbsup:

sophia: taking over. will summarize in the incident channel and convert to postmortem if kernel correlation confirmed.

incidents-bot: THREAD CLOSED: will re-open on new alerts or manual update.
